items.title: Ruthie Foster interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 28, 2023
items.q: I wanted to honor, I really wanted to honor my drummer and friend Samantha Banks.

ctx.x: It’s like, and it sounds like there was more arranging to be done with some horn parts and a choir and so forth. Was there a discussion about this next CD is going to sound somewhat different from what came before it?

I think it was unconsciously done that way. We — I did want to write with my band on this one. This was the first album we’ve actually written together and that was huge for me because I had — we had just come out of the pandemic, just that January, out of the pandemic and started recording. And not even just recording but writing. We were recording and writing about the same time as much as we could. And I wanted to honor, I really wanted to honor my drummer and friend Samantha Banks. She passed away in ’19, in…
How many people are usually in on the mixing?
